asset_heavy.reason: Cloud HCM software platform; growth needs software development and staff, not plants or fleets.

big_ticket.reason: Subscription payroll and HR software billed per employee regularly; small frequent payments rather than large infrequent purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Payroll and HR compliance software is essential; customers must keep running payroll, though hiring declines affect per-employee fees somewhat.

large_customers.reason: Targets small and mid-sized businesses, from local boutiques to growing franchises, not mainly large enterprises.

notes: Payroll processing and support services exist, but the cloud software platform is the core offering.

offers_products.reason: Sells SaaS HCM platform covering HR, payroll, spend management and IT asset management.

offers_services.reason: Payroll processing and tax filing are delivered through the software; support is bundled with the platform.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for the software platform and automation, not mainly staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscription SaaS for payroll and HR, billed per employee on an ongoing basis.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sold to employers, HR, finance and IT teams; employees use it but the employer chooses it.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are businesses, franchises, associations and brokerage firms buying HR and payroll software.
